kamloops.title: Penticton, B.C., city councillor found guilty of historic sexual offences involving a child
kamloops.description: A Penticton, B.C., city councillor has been found guilty of four counts of sexual interference and one count of invitation to sexual touching. The charges stem from his time as a youth basketball coach in Sarnia, Ont.

kamloops.title: Hotel Eldorado says it is ready to mediate with City of Kelowna over contentious boardwalk property
kamloops.description: The owners of a hotel mired in a legal controversy over access to a waterfront boardwalk say they are prepared to mediate with the City of Kelowna rather than fight in the courts.

prince-george.title: Dawson Creek residents say municipal animal control services a ballot box issue
prince-george.description: In May, city council voted to end its contract with the SPCA, saying it would save taxpayers roughly $300,000. The contact expires on Dec. 1 and will not be replaced.

southeast.title: Great Dane stretchered off mountain near Revelstoke, B.C., in unusual rescue
southeast.description: Rescuers say the owners were exhausted from trying to get the 10-year-old dog off the mountain, and were not prepared for overnight stays in alpine terrain.

southeast.title: Multiple people treated after rabies found in skunk in Kootenay Lake region of B.C.
southeast.description: The health authority is now warning that anyone else who may have been exposed to the disease should seek immediate emergency medical care.
